title: 第17章 挑选武技第18章 天火拳

;;
周尘将后院稍作清理，安抚好受惊的林清萱，并叮嘱她近日务必小心后，便再次回到了炼丹房。
他心念一动，带着剩余的药材和丹炉，重新进入阴阳塔炼丹。
“纯阳灵力虽强，但若无合适武技引导，终究难以发挥十成威力，更缺乏变化。”
“林远山境界比我高，赵远山更不用说，他拜入天地门，没少修炼武技。”
武技珍贵，往往是一个家族或宗门的底蕴所在，极少外传。
市面上流通的多是些大路货色，想要获得高品阶武技，难如登天。
“摘星楼包罗万象，底蕴深厚，或许会有品阶不错的武技出售。”
“昨日售卖丹药赚取了大量灵石，应该足够购买一门不错的武技了。”
想来想去，目前唯一可能获得上武技的途径，似乎也只有资源广泛的摘星楼了。
而且，自己如今已是摘星楼的客卿炼丹师。
有这个身份在，购买武技或许还能有些便利，说不定还能接触到更好的资源。
心中有了想法，周尘便加快速度，将丹药尽数炼制完毕。
外界天色微亮时，周尘离开了阴阳塔。
他将丹药交给林清萱，简单交代了几句，便离开百草轩，朝着城中的摘星楼走去。
听闻周尘到来，方青瓷很快便亲自迎了出来，依旧是那袭淡青衣，笑靥如花：
“周公子今日前来，可是有需要什么药材？”
周尘拱手，开门见山：“方小姐，今日前来，是想看看贵楼是否有适合我的武技。”
“武技？”方青瓷美眸中闪过一丝讶异，随即了然一笑：
“我摘星楼打开门做生意，丹药、兵器、功法武技，皆有涉猎。”

她很是爽快，侧身做了个请的手势：“周公子如今是我摘星楼的客卿，不是外人，可以免费兑换一次武技。”
“请随我来，我带你去武技阁一看。”
周尘一定又能白嫖，心中顿时一喜：“有劳方小姐了。”
在方青辞的引领下，两人来到很快摘星楼后院一处独立阁楼前。
阁楼门口，一位身着白袍的老者正闭目休息，气息沉静如水，深不可测。
方青辞上前一步，恭敬地行礼道：“方老。”
白袍老者缓缓睁开双眼，先在方青辞身上停留一瞬，随后便落在了周尘身上，上下打量了一番。
方青辞连忙介绍道：“周公子，这位是方鸿儒方老，负责看守我天风城摘星楼的武技阁。”
她又对方老说道：“方老，这位是周尘周公子，是我们摘星楼新聘的客卿炼丹师。周公子需要挑选一门武技修炼，麻烦您老开放阁楼，允他入内挑选一部。”
方老闻言，似乎对周尘这么年轻就成为客卿炼丹师颇为意外。
他袖袍轻轻一挥，身后的木门便无声无息地滑开，露出里面一排排陈列整齐的武技秘境。
“进去吧。你只有一炷香的时间，选中心仪的之后，再来老夫这里登记兑换。”
“多谢方老。”周尘拱手致谢，当即便迈步进入武技阁楼。
他在阁楼内缓步行走，目光扫过一排排陈列的玉简古籍。
“《碎石拳》，黄阶上品，修炼至大成，拳出可碎巨石…”
“《追风步》，黄阶上品，身法武技，施展时如疾风掠影…”
“《叠浪掌》，黄阶上品，掌力层层叠加，一浪强过一浪…”
他随手翻看了几本，微微摇头。
这些武技虽然不错，但总觉得与自身纯阳道体不够契合，威力也未能达到他的预期。
“果然，分楼的收藏还是以黄阶为主。”周尘心中了然。

玄阶武技太过珍贵，往往被各大家族和宗门视为核心传承，轻易不会外流。在这天风城，能买到黄阶上品武技已属不易。

Zhou Chen cleaned up the backyard a little, comforted the frightened Lin Qingxuan, and told her to be careful in the near future, and then returned to the alchemy room again.
With a thought in his mind, he took the remaining medicinal materials and the alchemy furnace and re-entered the Yin-Yang Tower to refine elixirs.
"Although pure Yang spiritual power is strong, without the guidance of suitable martial arts, it will be difficult to exert 100% of its power, let alone change."
"Lin Yuanshan's realm is higher than mine, let alone Zhao Yuanshan's. He worshiped at the Gate of Heaven and Earth and practiced martial arts a lot."
Martial arts are precious and are often the secret of a family or sect, and are rarely passed down to the outside world.
Most of the goods circulating in the market are cheap goods, and it is difficult to obtain high-level martial arts skills.
"The Star Reaching Tower is all-encompassing and has a profound foundation. There may be good-grade martial arts for sale."
"I earned a lot of spiritual stones from selling pills yesterday, which should be enough to buy a good martial art."
After much deliberation, it seems that the only possible way to obtain advanced martial arts skills is through the Star Reaching Tower, which has extensive resources.
Moreover, he is now the guest alchemist of Zhaixing Tower.
With this status, it may be easier to purchase martial arts skills, and maybe you can have access to better resources.
With an idea in mind, Zhou Chen speeded up and refined all the elixirs.
When the sky outside was getting slightly brighter, Zhou Chen left the Yin-Yang Tower.
He handed the elixir to Lin Qingxuan, explained a few words briefly, and then left Baicao Pavilion and walked towards the Star Reaching Tower in the city.
After hearing Zhou Chen's arrival, Fang Qingci quickly welcomed him out in person, still dressed in light green clothes and smiling like a flower:
"Master Zhou is here today, but do you need any medicinal materials?"
Zhou Chen raised his hand and said straight to the point: "Miss Fang, I came here today to see if your building has martial arts suitable for me."
"Martial skills?" A trace of surprise flashed in Fang Celadon's beautiful eyes, and then she smiled knowingly:
"I opened the door of Zhaixinglou to do business. I am involved in elixirs, weapons, martial arts and martial arts."
She was very happy and made an invitation gesture sideways: "Young Master Zhou is now my guest at Zhaixinglou. He is not an outsider. You can exchange martial arts for free."
"Please come with me, I will take you to the Martial Arts Pavilion."
Zhou Chen must be able to have sex for nothing again, and he suddenly felt happy: "I have Miss Laofang."
Under the guidance of Fang Qingci, the two came to an independent attic in the backyard of Jiuxingxinglou.
At the door of the attic, an old man in a white robe was resting with his eyes closed, his breath as calm as water and unfathomable.
Fang Qingci took a step forward and saluted respectfully: "Mr. Fang."
The old man in white robe slowly opened his eyes, first resting on Fang Qingci for a moment, and then on Zhou Chen, looking up and down.
Fang Qingci quickly introduced: "Master Zhou, this is Mr. Fang Hongru, who is responsible for guarding the Martial Arts Pavilion of our Tianfeng City Star Reaching Tower."
She then said to Mr. Fang: "Mr. Fang, this is Mr. Zhou Chen, Mr. Zhou, the newly hired alchemist of our guest at Zhaixing Tower. Mr. Zhou needs to choose a martial art to practice. Could you please open the attic and allow him to come in and choose one."
Hearing this, Mr. Fang seemed quite surprised that Zhou Chen became the alchemist of Ke Qing at such a young age.
With a slight wave of his sleeves, the wooden door behind him slid open silently, revealing rows of neatly displayed martial arts secrets inside.
"Go in. You only have one stick of incense. After you choose the one you like, come to me to register and redeem."
"Thank you, Mr. Fang." Zhou Chen thanked him with his hands and immediately stepped into the martial arts loft.
He walked slowly in the attic, his eyes scanning the rows of jade slips and ancient books displayed.
""Smashing Stone Fist", a top-grade yellow-ranked person who has practiced to great perfection and can punch huge rocks that can be broken..."
""Chasing the Wind Step", a top-grade yellow-level martial arts skill. When used, it is like a fleeting shadow of the wind..."
""The Palm of Overlapping Waves", a top-grade yellow grade, the palm power is stacked layer by layer, one wave is stronger than the other..."
He flipped through a few books and shook his head slightly.
Although these martial arts are good, I always feel that they are not suitable for my pure Yang Dao body, and the power is not enough.can meet his expectations.
"Sure enough, the collection in the branch building is still dominated by Huang Jie." Zhou Chen understood clearly.
Xuan level martial arts skills are so precious that they are often regarded as core inheritance by major families and sects and cannot be easily leaked out. In Tianfeng City, it is not easy to buy high-grade yellow-level martial arts.
